reason: Three sources had only 3–6 replies out of 17–21 transmitted requests in 30 minutes.
Current non-smear handling is explicit for Cloudflare; national UTC/older leap handling documentation for the other sources is not a current end-to-end policy attestation.
The real 4.5 failure tests did not demonstrate automatic selection change within 600 seconds.
configuration_role: Exact first tested source set for review and transition reproduction only; not a recommended replacement.

dns_policy.candidate: Four literal IPv4 addresses, no pool/server DNS, no include/sourcedir; observed 91.189.91.157 cannot be reintroduced by DNS in this file.
limits: Pinned addresses can change ownership or disappear.
Same IP does not prove same physical server or path (anycast).
Rollback restores original ntp.ubuntu.com pool semantics and can reintroduce the problem address.

independence.confirmed: Different documented operators and observed BGP origin ASNs.
independence.not_confirmed: End-to-end paths and independent upstream clocks; the home router, ISP and host remain shared.
